mapper.sql: o.id,o.course_id,c.course_code,c.name course_name,c.course_type,c.credit,c.weekly_periods, o.teacher_id,t.teacher_no,t.name teacher_name,o.class_id,ac.class_name, o.semester_id,sem.name semester_name,o.capacity, (select count(*) from student_course total where total.offering_id=o.id) student_count
from course_offering o join course c on c.id=o.course_id join teacher t on t.id=o.teacher_id join administrative_class ac on ac.id=o.class_id join semester sem on sem.id=o.semester_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from student_course where student_id=#{studentId} and offering_id=#{offeringId}
select count(*) from student_course sc join course_offering o on o.id=sc.offering_id where sc.student_id=#{studentId} and o.course_id=#{courseId} and o.semester_id=#{semesterId}
mapper.delete: delete from student_course where student_id=#{studentId} and offering_id=#{offeringId}
mapper.select: select join student_course selected on selected.offering_id=o.id where selected.student_id=#{studentId} and o.semester_id=#{semesterId} order by c.course_code
